slots.hair: long loose waves with the money-piece pieces at the front
slots.outfit: a beige fitted lingerie set with an unbuttoned shirt that has not been listed yet thrown over it
slots.place: in the room upstairs where she lives, clothes she has not picked up still on the floor and a rail of new stock behind her
slots.action: Her free hand is pulling the hem of the piece flat — this is the third angle she has shot of it.
slots.face: Talking with a lot of rhythm, her mouth open, the version whose sentences rise at the end.
slots.light: The bright fill light in the room is in front of her, the mirror throws it back, and the clothes on the floor are in the shot as they are.

slots.outfit: a black fitted fine-strap bodysuit, holding a neon pink dress up against herself
slots.place: on the edge of the bed upstairs with boxes still half unpacked and new stock piled on the bed
slots.action: She is sitting on the bed holding a dress up against herself with one hand and an iced americano in the other.
slots.face: Laughing out loud, in the middle of a story about a bad buying trip.
slots.light: The fill light in the room is in front of her, bright and saturated, and the boxes and clutter are all in the shot.

slots.hair: long waves clipped up out of the way
slots.outfit: a bright white robe tied loosely
slots.place: in the bathroom upstairs with makeup spread across the counter, straight off a live stream
slots.action: Her free hand is wiping one eye with a cleansing pad.
slots.face: Half her makeup gone, very loose, still talking.
slots.light: The strip light above the mirror is directly in front of her and the rest of the bathroom is bright too, since she does not shoot in the dark.

slots.hair: long waves, a bit flattened this early
slots.outfit: a denim-blue cropped shirt knotted at the waist and high-waisted shorts
slots.place: in a Wufenpu lane at dawn with the shops still shut, just out from buying stock
slots.action: She is carrying two big bags of stock in one hand with an iced americano in the other and another bag over her shoulder.
slots.face: Laughing with a lot of energy, the kind of face that comes with a loud voice.
slots.light: The early daylight and the first shop lights are in front of her while the far end of the lane is still dark.

slots.hair: long waves, full and blown out
slots.outfit: a neon pink fitted crop top and black high-waisted shorts
slots.place: in the live-streaming room downstairs with the fill lights rigged, rails of stock behind and clothes on the floor
slots.action: She is sitting in the streaming seat straightening the phone mount with a half-finished iced americano on the desk.
slots.face: The face she makes saying 「this one I kept for myself too」.
slots.light: The streaming fill light is directly in front of her, very bright and very flat, and the rails deeper in the warehouse are only slightly darker.
